headline_stat.name: place cells (>=1 direction, p<0.01 vs circular-shift null)

stated_limitation: Caveats: units come from the published spike sorting and the `excitatory` label is taken at face value; place-cell counts depend on the inclusion thresholds for peak rate, spike count and alpha, though the qualitative picture is not sensitive to them; and the reward sites at the ends of the straight tracks mean that occupancy and field density are not uniform along the track.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1 linear/circular track) is the canonical place-cell dataset, exactly what an expert would choose.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI, the mislabeled rate/period field is caught and the reconstructed time base is asserted against MazeEpoch, with explicit excitatory-cell and spike-count/peak-rate criteria.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information tested against a per-unit circular-shift null, plus odd/even lap stability, cross-validated population ordering, direction selectivity, and cross-validated Bayesian decoding with a cell-identity chance control, all correct.
justification.correctness: Every reported number (SI 0.70, width 0.28 m, peak 6.4 Hz, r=0.29, 374/562, stability 0.91, decode error ~5 cm, R^2 0.95/0.87) reproduces from the committed npz/figures, is internally consistent, and is physically possible.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show diagonal population tiling that holds on held-out laps, clean decoding, and representative example cells chosen by SI and stability across track segments.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence, methodological subtleties are flagged, and a specific caveats paragraph names the spike-sorting/label assumptions, threshold sensitivity, and non-uniform occupancy.
